title: Fix real FLA import: OLE2 parser extracts no layers, symbols, or display objects
description:
Task 0107 (real-fla-import) is marked done but the implementation is skeletal. packages/core/src/fla/ole.ts line 307 logs: 'Layer structure and display objects are not extracted from this format version.' Only stage size, FPS, and background color are recovered — all timeline content, library symbols, and display objects are silently discarded.

A user opening a real Macromedia Flash 8 .fla file gets a blank document with correct dimensions. This breaks the core FLA I/O promise.

Acceptance criteria:
- Open a real Flash 8 .fla file; all layers and their frames appear in the timeline.
- Library symbols (graphics, movie clips, buttons) are imported into the library panel.
- Display objects on each frame are placed at their authored positions with correct transforms.
- Existing fla/ole.test.ts passes and gains at least one fixture test using a real binary .fla.

Key files: packages/core/src/fla/ole.ts (OLE2 parser), packages/core/src/fla/deserialize.ts (Flash XML deserializer — check what it already handles), packages/core/src/fla/zip.ts.
